title: Bigger than CRISPR? A guide to the latest genome editors
title_zh: 超越CRISPR？最新基因编辑工具指南
abstract: Gene-editing techniques could soon allow researchers to replace entire genes and engineer complex cellular circuits — if the systems can be delivered safely into cells.
abstract_zh: 基因编辑技术或将使研究人员能够替换整个基因并构建复杂的细胞电路——前提是这些系统能够安全地递送到细胞中。
snippet: Gene-editing techniques could soon allow researchers to replace entire genes and engineer complex cellular circuits — if the systems can be delivered safely into cells.
